title: An Actionable Diagnosis of Multilingual, Multi-Agent Planning Failures
title_zh: 多语言多智能体规划失败的可操作诊断
abstract_en: Multilingual multi-agent systems exhibit substantial degradation beyond English, yet prior work rarely identifies how task-critical information is lost when user requests are converted into executable plans. We study the planner in a multi-agent system as the request-to-action interface and derive an actionable taxonomy of planning-grounding failures from failed real-world task executions. LLM-based analysis shows that these failures constitute an increasing share of unsuccessful executions as language-resource availability declines, with the strongest effects in low-resource languages. To test whether the taxonomy supports mitigation, we introduce TART, Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation, that makes the taxonomy's key aspects explicit to the planner and downstream sub-agents. Across multiple languages, three LLM backbones, two datasets, and two agentic configurations, TART consistently improves performance. On multilingual GAIA, it raises a state-of-the-art system's accuracy by 5.6 percentage points averaged across eleven languages spanning low- to high-resource settings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究多语言 Multi-Agent Systems 在非英语场景下性能显著下降的原因，重点关注用户请求被转换为可执行计划时，任务关键信息如何丢失。作者将多智能体系统中的 planner 视为“请求到行动”的接口，并基于真实任务执行失败案例，提出一套可操作的规划落地失败分类法。LLM 分析表明，随着语言资源可用性降低，这类规划失败在失败执行中的占比持续上升，在低资源语言中影响最强。为验证该分类法能否指导缓解，作者提出 TART（Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation），将分类法中的关键因素显式提供给 planner 和下游 sub-agents。实验覆盖多种语言、三种 LLM backbone、两个数据集和两种 agentic configuration，结果显示 TART 稳定提升性能；在 multilingual GAIA 上，它使一个 state-of-the-art 系统在覆盖低到高资源的 11 种语言上平均准确率提升 5.6 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 论文聚焦多语言 Multi-Agent Systems 中 planner 的失败机制，分析用户请求到可执行计划转换过程中任务关键信息的丢失。
作者从真实世界任务失败执行中归纳出一套 actionable taxonomy，用于描述 planning-grounding failures，即规划与任务落地之间的错配。
LLM-based analysis 显示，语言资源越低，规划落地失败在总体失败中的占比越高，低资源语言受影响最明显。
提出 TART（Taxonomy-Guided Actionable Representation），将分类法中的关键信息显式注入 planner 与下游 sub-agents，以改善执行表现。
在 multilingual GAIA 等实验中，TART 跨语言、LLM backbone、数据集和智能体配置均带来稳定提升，并使 SOTA 系统在 11 种语言上平均准确率提升 5.6 个百分点。

llm_assessment.comment: Grounding multilingual planning failures in failed executions and feeding the taxonomy back into agent planning makes this practically relevant for agent reliability.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作从失败执行中归纳多语言规划故障并反馈到智能体规划，对提升智能体可靠性有实际价值。
